g.text: Position error after a spoofing alarm, with and without the fallback

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Fused detector raises the alarm; the fallback then drops GPS and navigates on the IMU (learned bias) and barometer (imu variant, roll back 0 s, chosen on validation flights). Line: median over runs; band: middle half. Truth = the unspoofed GPS
